title: Cancelling a Gym Membership
context: A gym member visits reception to ask about cancelling their membership.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Hi there, welcome to Pulse Fitness. How can I help you today?

script.speaker: Member
script.text: Hi, I'm afraid I need to cancel my membership. I'm moving to a different city next month.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Oh, sorry to hear you're leaving us. Let's sort that out. Can I take your name and membership number?

script.speaker: Member
script.text: Yes, it's Jake Turner, and the membership number is 22581.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Let me just check that. 22581, Jake Turner. Yes, I've found your account here.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: Great. So, what do I need to do?

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Normally we ask for one month's notice, but because your contract is a twelve-month plan, you're actually required to give thirty days' notice in writing, not just verbally.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: Oh, I didn't realise it had to be in writing.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: It's easy though — you can either fill in a short form here at reception, or email us, whichever suits you.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: I'll fill in the form now, if that's alright.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Of course. Now, your last payment was on the fifth of this month, so your final payment will actually be next month, on the fifth, and your membership will end thirty days after that.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: So I'll still be charged one more time?

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Yes, I'm afraid so — one more payment of 38 pounds, and then no more charges after that.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: 38 pounds, okay, that's fair enough given the notice period.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Now, do you have a gym bag stored in one of our lockers, or any equipment on loan from us?

script.speaker: Member
script.text: I do have a yoga mat I borrowed, actually.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Please bring that back before your membership ends, or we'll have to charge a replacement fee of 15 pounds.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: I'll bring it next time I come in, no problem.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Great. Also, if you ever move back to this city, just so you know, returning members don't have to pay the joining fee again, so it's worth keeping your membership number safe.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: Good to know, I'll keep it somewhere safe.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: One last thing — would you like to keep receiving our email newsletter, or shall I remove you from that too?

script.speaker: Member
script.text: You can remove me from the newsletter as well, thanks.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: No problem, that's all done. Before you go, can I ask what made you choose us in the first place, just for our records?

script.speaker: Member
script.text: Honestly, it was the location, really — I could walk here from my flat in about five minutes, which made it easy to come regularly.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: That's really useful feedback, thank you. And is there anything you think we could have done better?

script.speaker: Member
script.text: The only thing I'd mention is that the changing rooms could do with an upgrade — they're a bit small compared with some other gyms I've visited.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: Thanks, I'll pass that on to the manager. We're actually planning some renovations next year, so hopefully that's already on the list.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: Good to hear. Well, I've really enjoyed my time here overall.

script.speaker: Staff Member
script.text: I'm sorry to see you go, Jake, and good luck with the move.

script.speaker: Member
script.text: Thanks very much for your help.

questions.instruction: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.explanation: The member states his membership number as "22581," and the staff member repeats it to confirm the correct account.

questions.sentence: Reason for cancelling: moving to a different ___
questions.explanation: The member explains at the start, "I'm moving to a different city next month," which is the stated reason for cancelling.

questions.sentence: Notice period required: ___ days, in writing
questions.explanation: One month's notice is mentioned generally, but the staff member clarifies the actual requirement is "thirty days' notice in writing, not just verbally."
The staff member confirms there will be "one more payment of 38 pounds, and then no more charges after that."

questions.sentence: Item borrowed by the member: a ___
questions.explanation: When asked about borrowed equipment, the member says, "I do have a yoga mat I borrowed, actually."

questions.sentence: Replacement fee if the item isn't returned: £___
questions.explanation: The staff member warns that failing to return the item means "we'll have to charge a replacement fee of 15 pounds."

questions.sentence: Returning members do not have to pay the ___ fee again
questions.explanation: The staff member mentions that if he rejoins later, "returning members don't have to pay the joining fee again," a benefit tied to keeping his membership number.

questions.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.question: How does the member choose to submit his cancellation request?
options: by sending an email to the office
by filling in a form at reception
questions.explanation: He is offered a form or email and says, "I'll fill in the form now, if that's alright," choosing the in-person form.

questions.question: When was the member's most recent payment made?
options: on the fifth of this month
on the fifth of next month
questions.explanation: The staff member says, "your last payment was on the fifth of this month," and the next payment, not the last one, falls next month.

questions.question: What does the member decide about the email newsletter?
options: he wants to keep receiving it
he asks to be removed from it
questions.explanation: When asked, he replies, "You can remove me from the newsletter as well, thanks," choosing to unsubscribe.
